test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) Crack two eggs into it.
(2) Whisk the mixture well.
(3) Take a clean bowl.
(4) Add salt and pepper to the eggs
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To arrange the sentences logically, we need to identify the sequence of actions that follow a step-by-step process.
 
• **Sentence 3** is the first step as it indicates the starting action, which is to take a clean bowl.
